extension.description: Multi-person AI chat in VS Code with the host's GitHub Copilot models: host or join a session, an agent confined to the project, and the host stays in control. Independent project, not affiliated with GitHub or Microsoft.
config.port.description: Local port (127.0.0.1) of the shared chat server.
config.modelFamily.description: Family of the Copilot model used by default (e.g. "gpt-4o", "claude-sonnet-4"). Empty: first available Copilot model. Can be changed with "Prompt Share: Select Default Model".
config.language.description: Language of Prompt Share (chat, notifications). Each participant has their own; it can also be changed from the chat.
config.language.enum.0: VS Code's language (English if it is not supported)
config.tunnelProvider.description: Tunnel service preselected in "Invite" (the last one chosen is remembered). You choose the service each time you open a tunnel; if one fails, the extension offers the other. The tool is downloaded from its official source, with your consent, if it is not installed.
config.tunnelProvider.enum.0: Cloudflare quick tunnel (cloudflared): no account, no warning page; a new address for each session.
config.tunnelProvider.enum.1: ngrok: free account and token required; fixed address tied to the account, warning page in browsers, 1 GB per month.
config.notifications.description: VS Code notifications during a session, hosted or joined from VS Code.
config.notifications.enum.0: When a decision awaits you: guest question to accept (host), agent action to approve, agent question.
config.notifications.enum.1: Like "decisions", plus every new question from other participants and every answer to your questions.
config.notifications.enum.2: No notifications (the view badge and the status bar still show pending decisions).
config.reviewGuestQuestions.description: Each guest question waits for your approval before being sent to the model (notification in VS Code and buttons in the chat). Guest questions use your GitHub Copilot account.
config.guestQuestionsPerHour.description: Maximum number of guest questions sent to the model per hour, for the whole session (0: no limit). A question you explicitly accept goes through even beyond the limit.
config.allowGuestModelChoice.description: Lets guests choose a model other than the default one. All requests use your Copilot quota, including premium models.
config.historyLength.description: Number of previous exchanges sent to the model with each question.
config.hostName.description: Your name in sessions, whether you host or join (empty: system user name).
config.agentMode.description: The model's access to the host's workspace. In an untrusted workspace, access is limited to reading.
config.agentMode.enum.0: Read, edit files and run commands; each edit or command is approved by the author of the request or the host (the host alone for commands outside the project).
config.nativeChat.description: Shows the session's conversations in VS Code's native Chat panel (proposed API: requires F5 or --enable-proposed-api local.prompt-share).
config.protectedFiles.description: Additional glob patterns of files hidden from the agent (added to the default list: .git, .env, keys, .npmrc, .ssh…).
config.sandboxReadOnlyPaths.description: Additional Linux folders visible read-only in the command sandbox (e.g. a toolchain installed outside /usr; under WSL, paths of the distribution). PATH folders are already included.
config.wslSandbox.description: On Windows: isolates the agent's commands in WSL with bubblewrap (as on Linux) if WSL 2 and bubblewrap are available. Otherwise, each command must be approved by the host.
config.wslDistro.description: WSL distribution used for the sandbox (empty: default distribution).
config.wslMode.description: On Windows, if WSL is installed: what to do when a session starts. Anything missing (bubblewrap, WSL extension) is installed with your consent.
config.wslMode.enum.0: Ask when a session starts whether to reopen the project in WSL.
config.wslMode.enum.1: Always reopen the project in WSL (works exactly as on Linux).
config.wslMode.enum.2: Stay on Windows (commands isolated through WSL when possible).
chatSessions.description: Conversations of the Prompt Share session shared with guests
